title: Unless predicates gate mutations after state changes
description: An unless branch changes the gate, which prevents the same branch from running twice; its inverse then runs.

steps.command: execute unless score gate pp_exec matches 1 run scoreboard players set gate pp_exec 1
execute unless score gate pp_exec matches 1 run scoreboard players add count pp_exec 10
execute if score gate pp_exec matches 1 unless score count pp_exec matches 1 run scoreboard players add count pp_exec 1
execute if score gate pp_exec matches 1 if score count pp_exec matches 1
